bf-e40ace89ce2e110b662b61ac.what: Invalid agent payload is classified BAD_REQUEST but sent as HTTP 500.
bf-e40ace89ce2e110b662b61ac.root_cause: createRpcRouter supplied a custom errorStatusMap without COMMON_ERROR_STATUS_MAP. oRPC treats that map as a replacement, so unmapped standard errors defaulted to 500.
bf-e40ace89ce2e110b662b61ac.fixed_by: Merge oRPC standard error statuses before configured domain overrides. Same real API reproduction and regression tests now pass.
